d: A couple share their Christmas Love Story with a friend to encourage that love and miracles still happen around Christmas.

Stan and Kelly Stevenson seem to be more committed to growing apart rather than growing together. Their friends are caught in the middle of divorce conversations during one of the most joyous seasons of the year.
An activist and chef caters a Christmas dinner for a wealthy family that threatens her home.
To avoid nagging from her family for the holidays, a woman invites her co-worker to pose as her boyfriend.
To save her family home before Christmas, a woman devises a plan to win a televised holiday contest.
After her pact fails with her best friend, a woman looks to a sperm donor to have a baby before Christmas which also happens to be her 35th birthday.

Holiday, a female impersonator, bonds with a child and her drug-addicted mother and helps them off the street. But when the mom hooks up with a drug dealer, it forces Holiday to confront his own prejudices if it means saving the two people he loves.
An exotic dancer meets her doctor boyfriend's family over the holidays.
